1.web: Yahweh, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.
1.asv: Jehovah, thou hast been favorable unto thy land; Thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.

2.web: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin. Selah.
2.asv: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people; Thou hast covered all their sin. [Selah

3.web: You have taken away all your wrath. You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.
3.asv: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath; Thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger.

4.web: Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.
4.asv: Turn us, O God of our salvation, And cause thine indignation toward us to cease.

5.web: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?
5.asv: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? Wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?

6.web: Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?
6.asv: Wilt thou not quicken us again, That thy people may rejoice in thee?

7.web: Show us your loving kindness, Yahweh. Grant us your salvation.
7.asv: Show us thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, And grant us thy salvation.

8.web: I will hear what God, Yahweh, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.
8.asv: I will hear what God Jehovah will speak; For he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: But let them not turn again to folly.

9.web: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.
9.asv: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him, That glory may dwell in our land.

10.web: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.
10.asv: Mercy and truth are met together; Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

11.web: Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven.
11.asv: Truth springeth out of the earth; And righteousness hath looked down from heaven.

12.web: Yes, Yahweh will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.
12.asv: Yea, Jehovah will give that which is good; And our land shall yield its increase.

13.web: Righteousness goes before him, And prepares the way for his steps.
13.asv: Righteousness shall go before him, And shall make his footsteps a way to walk in.
